extraction_notes: F2 data extracted from the supplied datasheet: 25 degC transfer curve, five output curves, and Ciss/Coss/Crss capacitance-versus-VDS curves were digitized before using tabulated values.
All p-channel plotted and fitted values are stored as positive magnitudes; signed source-datasheet conditions are retained in the conditions text.
RDS(ON) typical is 3.2 ohm at VGS = -5 V and ID = -0.100 A; the same datasheet row publishes a 10 ohm maximum, but this schema stores one resistance value per point.
The supplied datasheet does not publish a body-diode forward-voltage or reverse-recovery specification, so body_diode is null.
The supplied datasheet publishes IDSS and gate-charge data, but those fields are not represented by the supplied MOSFET extraction schema.
Digitized curve points are approximate readings from the cited figures and preserve the cited axes and test conditions.
omission_reason: Body-diode forward-voltage and reverse-recovery data are not published in the supplied datasheet; IDSS, gate charge, and thermal ratings are not representable in the supplied extraction schema.
